title: Symrise accelerates innovation and champions longevity and inner beauty at in-cosmetics global 2026
summary: ‒ Participation as a founding exhibitor in the Inner Beauty Zone presenting its Care & Wellness Division ‒ Launch of three cosmetic ingredients: Cellexora® MD, Mindera® Euca, and SymConcentrole® Barrier Boost ‒ Presentation of ‘Good Planets Are Hard to Find’ campaign, highlighting longevity and sustainability ‒ Experts to lead R&D Tours, Formulation Lab sessions, a technical seminar and more
